rules.name: Lateral Movement chain — RDP → Credential Access → Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects multi-stage lateral movement: initial RDP compromise followed by credential theft and data exfiltration
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "lateral-movement" or Message contains "chain" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
